_comment: Catalogue built pass by pass. Every entry below was verified against frames/overview/page_NNN.jpg before being written. Nothing is entered from the Wikipedia plot alone. Boundaries are snapped to _cuts.json where a detected cut falls within 2.5s; where no cut is near, the observed time is kept rather than forcing a false alignment - this film averages 4.9 cuts/min (Superbad: 16.3) and holds shots for 30s+ at a time.
_censor_note: No explicit content observed anywhere in the film (00:00:00-01:59:05.8). All entries censor=none. Two judgement calls, both left uncensored per S7: the care-home ward (01:41:33-01:43:13) and Amah's deathbed (01:49:30-01:51:20) show feeding/oxygen tubes and terminal illness, shot without graphic detail - S7 says implied and non-graphic medical content is not censored. No body is visible at the funeral; the coffin is closed throughout.
